title: senecio acaulis
intro: Senecio acaulis, commonly known as Mountain Ragwort, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, as well as a potential role in reducing fever and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Ragwort include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and ease menstrual cramps, among other uses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
